CultivarDefinition.name: Cindy
CultivarDefinition.Description: A young American Indian who was raised by a country western star in Tennessee. She was discovered by Kehmet, a lady of the Garden, because of her incomparable archery skills and that she possesses the bow of Aislyn. She is gay.
